findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple nozzles on the fountain drink machines were observed with accumulated soilage. The PIC was consulted and had the items cleaned/sanitized to correct. Ensure that all food contact surfaces are maintained cleaned and sanitized at all times in the facility.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

The sani buckets in the facility were not changed when they should have been and would not register sanitizer on the inspector’s test strips. The buckets were remade during the inspection to correct. Ensure that all sanitizers are maintained at effective levels at all times.

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.citation_text:
4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination.

Multiple locations throughout the food preparation areas are observed with single service food containers (plastic and cardboard) with the food contact surfaces up/exposed. This was discussed with the PIC and the containers flipped over to correct as they were observed. Ensure that the food contact surfaces of the single service food contact items in the facility are protected from contamination at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
(REPEAT FROM THE PRE-OPENING) 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. 

Men's restroom-reseal pipe cover behind the sink basin. The PIC was notified and instructed to reseal prior to the next routine inspection. Maintenance arrived during this inspection and corrected the violation prior to the inspector leaving.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean.

Milk is observed to be spilled and partially coagulated in the bottom of the drive thru reach in cooler. The PIC was shown and instructed to clean and maintain clean moving forward.
